name: NUSC 4610
title: Applied Sport Nutrition
description: Focuses on the practical application of sports nutrition principles to optimize athletic performance and recovery. Students will learn to assess athlete needs, develop individualized nutrition strategies, and implement evidence-based fueling, hydration, and supplementation plans across different sports and training cycles. Emphasis is placed on translating scientific knowledge into real-world practice, and communicating recommendations effectively to athletes, coaches, and support.
requirement_description: May not be taken for credit after passing NUSC 5610.
